$meta.note: The college said it would supply sample event details, but none were in the tender pack. These six events are invented for layout only — replace with the college's sample events before the demo. Dates and weekdays are internally consistent (checked).

events.title: Open Evening
events.summary: Meet tutors, tour our workshops, salons and kitchens, and get advice on courses, apprenticeships and funding.
description: Find out what it's like to study at Chelmsford College. Our tutors and current learners will be on hand to answer your questions.
You can tour our specialist facilities, talk to our Careers Advice Zone about the right course for you, and find out about financial support.
events.howToBook: Booking is free but places are limited. Book online and we'll email your confirmation and parking details.

events.title: Adult Learning Information Session
events.summary: Find out about part-time, evening and funded courses for adults.
description: A live online session covering courses for adults, funding and how to apply.
events.howToBook: Book online to receive the joining link.

events.title: Hair & Beauty Taster Day
events.summary: Try hands-on hairdressing and beauty skills in our professional salons.
description: Spend a morning in our salons with our tutors and current learners.
events.howToBook: Places are limited to 20 — book online.

events.title: Apprenticeships Advice Evening
events.summary: Everything you need to know about earning while you learn.
description: Talk to our apprenticeships team and local employers about current vacancies and how apprenticeships work.

events.title: Parents & Carers Q&A
events.summary: Ask our team about applications, support, fees and payments.
description: An online Q&A for parents and carers supporting a young person applying to college.
events.howToBook: Book online to receive the joining link.

events.title: Creative Arts Showcase
events.summary: See fashion, graphic design and performing arts work by our learners.
description: An evening exhibition and catwalk showcasing work by our creative arts learners.
